puzzles.FP1: 7 persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V live on 7 floors (1-7). T even floor. 2 between T-R. Q above R. V odd floor above T. P above U. S above Q.
puzzles.FP2: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E, F live on 6 floors. F on 6. B even. A below B. 2 between A-C. E above D.

questions.q: All A are B. Only a few B are C. No C is D. Conclusions: I. Some B are not D. II. All A can be C.
